hook.text: On this album Nelson plays the cavaquinho for the first time, an instrument he had given up for the guitar.

sentences.text: Songs recorded on the LP include 'Juízo Final', 'Folhas Secas', 'A Flor e o Espinho', 'Rugas' and 'Quando Eu Me Chamar Saudade'.
Guilherme de Brito co-wrote several songs with Nelson, among them 'Minha festa', 'Mulher sem alma' and 'A flor e o espinho'.
He also appears as a special guest on the Potpourri, the second track on side B.
Nourival Bahia, Jair do Cavaquinho and Joaquim also share writing credits with Nelson.

listen_for.text: Nelson plays the cavaquinho himself on this choro.
Guilherme de Brito is a special guest on this track.
